verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports cron-based scheduled tasks (docs-5), run states/visibility including delayed/queued/executing (docs-10), a runs list/dashboard with filtering (docs-1, docs-19), and pause/resume via waitpoint tokens (docs-6) plus community confirmation that scheduled tasks 'just work' (comm-16). However, there is no explicit documented overlap policy for cron schedules (e.g., skip/queue/allow-overlap semantics) and no dedicated 'upcoming runs' forecast view distinct from general run history. missing for 10: explicit cron overlap-policy configuration, a documented upcoming/next-run-times view, and independent verification of pause/resume specifically applied to scheduled cron runs.
